Name: CoD Retired Life Nyapu portraits
Author: gwrnori
Description:
A portrait mod of the characters Keegan and Ghost from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33220]Cod Retired Life[/url], but in Nyapu style by me!

Just download the file, unzip and copy it over the mod in the mod file. Easy peasy.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drop into your mods file, overwrite the original mod
